content.title: Boeing Shares Finally Recoup Losses From 2024 Midair Fiasco
content.summary: It closed at that exact price on Jan. 5, 2024, hours before a door-sized panel blew off of a Boeing jet during a flight operated by Alaska Air Group Inc. The stock tumbled as much as 45% in the 15 months after the incident.  Boeing shares have been on a roller-coaster ride since 2019.  Boeing is expected to deliver its first annual profit in seven years in 2026.
